limitations: Four familiar underlying seed blocks; sixteen worlds are not sixteen independent weeks.
All confidence intervals are descriptive under IID-week assumptions. Four successes imply only a 47.3% one-sided 95% qualification lower bound. Bootstrap cannot reveal unseen tails.
An operational interruption leaves the panel incomplete; complete-case means are not used to select a finalist.
Payment and tail models contain explicit unvalidated assumptions. Solver optimality is restricted to the supplied finite model.
No result here promotes a policy, establishes rank, or proves a global optimum.
